sloka: ते यूयमवगाहध्वं नर्मदां शर्मदां शुभाम् ।महापद्ममुखा मत्ता गङ्गामिव गहागजाः ।अस्यां स्नात्वा महानद्यां पाप्मानं विप्रमोक्ष्यथ ।। ७.३१.३२ ॥
transliteration: te yūyamavagāhadhvaṁ narmadāṁ śarmadāṁ śubhām ।mahāpadmamukhā mattā gaṅgāmiva gahāgajāḥ ।asyāṁ snātvā mahānadyāṁ pāpmānaṁ vipramokṣyatha ।। 7.31.32 ॥

translations.english: You should plunge into the auspicious and joy-giving Narmada river, just as rutting wild elephants led by Mahapadma plunge into the Ganga, and by bathing in this great river, you will be freed from sin.
